column4: cleat#2691: tier2-gate.yml's dedicated, -run-filtered rerun of TestALegacyAwaiterReplayLeavesAtMostTwoRowsAndUnregisterRemovesBoth (moved from tier 1 to plugins/eventtriggers, a tier-2 package, in #2684). tiers.yaml's generic tier2.rules.skips_allowed tolerates a skip in scripts/tier2-gate.sh's own sweep, which enforces no budget of its own; this zero budget fails the gate instead of reading green on a genuine t.Skip, the same pattern tiers.yaml:1060-1066 documents for tests/cross-language and tests/plugin-harness. Today that is reachable only on PostgreSQL (TestDB skips, rather than fails, when unconfigured and the default DSN is unreachable) -- engine/testutil/plugin_backend.go's NewPluginTestBackends omits a MySQL or MSSQL backend entirely when its DSN is unset, which emits no skip event at all, so the workflow's companion "assert all three dialects ran" step covers that absence; this ledger line covers only genuine skips. The report is -run-filtered to this one test, so a single __UNATTRIBUTED__ line suffices -- no per-dialect regex needed.
